context_for_next_testing_agent: Tested 3 improvements: (1) Signature Position - SignaturePad component accepts showPosition prop, displays Seite/X-Position/Y-Position fields, sign endpoint stores pos_x/pos_y/page in signature object. (2) Download Signed PDF - DocumentPanel shows 'Signiert' button with FileDown icon when sigCount > 0, calls /download-signed endpoint which generates PDF with ReportLab including position info. (3) Emoji Picker - LiveMeetingPage has emojiPickerOpen state, reactions button toggles picker, 24 emojis in 8-column grid, clicking emoji calls handleReaction and closes picker. (4) Mobile Sidebar - Sidebar.js has mobileOpen state, hamburger button (mobile-menu-toggle) visible on mobile, sidebar uses CSS transform translateX for show/hide, overlay appears when open.
